Package com.csse3200.game.components.minigames.blackjack

Class Blackjack

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.minigames.blackjack.Blackjack
public class Blackjack extends Object
Core Blackjack game logic used by the minigame. This class contains no UI code and is designed to be plugged into a screen later.

    • getMatchResult

      public Blackjack.MatchResult getMatchResult()
      Returns the state of the current match. The player wins on reaching WINS_NEEDED. The player loses when the dealer reaches it, or when a round ends and the player can no longer afford the next BET.

    • isMatchOver

      public boolean isMatchOver()
